name: Kingfishers
summary: One of the nine gangs tracked in the game, with three robbable operations.
body: PowerPyx lists three Kingfishers operations: the Fishing Shacks, Sunrise RV Park and the Manatee Motel.
PowerPyx's walkthrough mentions the Kingfishers as a group Brian Heder has had a run-in with.

facts.type: Gang (one of nine tracked under Progress > Gangs)

name: Kolts & Associates
summary: A gang around Port Gellhorn that deals pills and runs five robbable operations, including Kingpin Bowling.
body: PowerPyx lists five operations for the gang: Kingpin Bowling, June Warehouse, La Cascara Motel, Brooks Boatworks and one more not yet named.
PowerPyx says the Kolts sell painkillers and are based at docks and a compound, and that Kingpin Bowling is in Port Gellhorn.
Spelling varies: PowerPyx's gang guide writes Kolts & Associates, while the trophy text it quotes says Kolt & Associates.

name: M7
summary: One of the nine tracked gangs, with a compound and one other robbable operation.
body: PowerPyx lists the M7 Compound and one unnamed robbery opportunity for M7, and mentions M7 members living next to a house Mia Caminos is selling.
GTA Wiki's Marabunta Grande page says members with M7 tattoos appear in the launch trailer, treating M7 as that gang.

name: La Polilla Negra
summary: A Colombian cartel that launders money through Sinfrontera National Bank in Vice City.
body: PowerPyx describes La Polilla Negra as a Colombian cartel using the Sinfrontera National Bank in Tequesta and does not name its leader.
PowerPyx lists two operations for it, one being the Palmer Fishing Warehouse, and names Monty as a senior enforcer.

facts.type: Colombian drug cartel (one of nine tracked gangs)

name: San4San
summary: A Haitian street gang in Vice City with five robbable operations.
body: GTABase describes San4San as a Haitian street gang in Vice City and says it was revealed through official trailers and screenshots.
PowerPyx lists five San4San operations, including a studio named after Sound4Sound and JanJak's Garage.

name: PTT Youngin$
summary: A street gang from Southside, Vice City, with two robbable operations plus one tied to the Ultimate Edition.
body: GTABase and GTA Wiki both place the gang in Southside, Vice City, in Vice-Dale County; neither names a leader.
PowerPyx lists two operations for it and says a third robbery exclusive to the Ultimate Edition is not counted in gang progress.

name: The Guardia Brothers
summary: A Vice City gang that moves shipments by boat on the Vice River and has three robbable operations.
body: PowerPyx lists three Guardia Brothers operations, one named Casa Guardia.
PowerPyx's walkthrough shows the gang running a boat convoy on the Vice River.

name: Other Criminals
summary: The ninth gang category in the game's progress screen, covering 13 unaffiliated illegal operations.
body: PowerPyx lists 13 operations under this heading, among them an exotic animals front, Slator Towing Inc, Chatfield Storage & Logistics and a cigar import front.

facts.type: Catch-all category for unaffiliated criminal operations

name: Cellerica
summary: A recruiting group that sells Manifestick vapes and assigns each new member a mentor called a pillar.
body: PowerPyx says Cellerica provides members with housing, charges a fee, holds an initiation, and hands out a welcome kit with a cap and a Manifestick.
PowerPyx does not say whether it is a company or something else, and also spells the name Celeria in places.

name: Thrillbilly Mud Club crew
summary: Billy's dirt bike crew, based around the Thrillbilly Mud Club racing venue in Kelly County.
body: PowerPyx says the Mud Club hosts dirt races for prize money and has a merchandise shop, and lists Billy, Wyman, Ricky and Brittney as the crew.

name: Hit 'n' Run VC
summary: A street racing group that holds cash races in Salton, Vice City.
body: PowerPyx says the player can race with the Hit 'n' Run VC racers in Salton for prize money, with $3,000 for first place in the first race.

name: Kordell's crew
summary: A crew led by Kordell that the player helps in Chapter 4.
body: PowerPyx's walkthrough names the crew in two mission titles and gives no description.
